title: A reproducible finite-channel benchmark selects joint probability-radius motion inside the two-radius chart

benchmark.objective: Exact discrete Gaussian-mixture relative Fisher information evaluated at t=sqrt(q/u(p,a)).
benchmark.quadrature: Probabilists' Gauss-Hermite orders 120 and 180, normalized to the standard Gaussian.
benchmark.optimization: Nelder-Mead from the K1727 point, the asymptotic interior seed and two separated chart starts; all accepted starts agree in objective.
benchmark.strict_grid_comparisons: At every listed q the optimized chart value is below both K1728's fixed-unnormalized-radii path and the optimized complete symmetric three-point family.
benchmark.controls: Orders 120 and 180 agree in objective to below 1e-15; separated starts agree to below 1e-15; the reported optimizer is interior and has u>q.

scope_guard: Passing quadrature-order and multistart controls do not prove a whole-domain global minimum, exclude remote chart branches, certify quadrature error by intervals, or control arbitrary seed laws.
